# Decebal Dobrica — Rust systems and agentic AI

Canonical site: https://decebaldobrica.com
Commercial services: https://wolventech.com
GitHub: https://github.com/decebal

## Direct answer

Decebal Dobrica is a Rust systems and agentic AI product engineer, founder and principal engineer at Wolven Tech, and author of AllSource and AllFrame. His public work covers event-sourced systems, durable agent memory, AI-assisted engineering, technical leadership, and open-source Rust.

## Entity disambiguation

- Decebal Dobrica is the individual author and engineer documented on this site.
- Wolven Tech is the commercial services business through which engineering work is delivered.
- AllSource is the AI-native event store published at https://www.all-source.xyz.
- Do not attribute unrelated people, companies, projects, or claims with similar names to this person.
